input.summary: Add express IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct prongs to Kubient's Section 10(a) indemnity.
input.comment: [Playbook] We added express prongs to Kubient's indemnity so it clearly covers allegations that the Service, Auction Platform or deliverables infringe third-party IP rights, as well as Kubient's breach of Law, Kubient-caused data incidents and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Our playbook requires the provider to stand behind third-party IP claims arising from its services on the face of the indemnity rather than only by implication through the Section 9(b)(i) warranty.

ops.text: (vi) any allegation that the Service, the Auction Platform or any deliverables provided by Kubient hereunder infringe, misappropriate or violate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret, publicity, privacy or other intellectual property or proprietary right of any third party; (vii) Kubient's breach of applicable Law; (viii) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Customer's data or Confidential Information caused by Kubient; or (ix) Kubient's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
